summary: Orion Digital Corp. filed a Form 6-K (Report of Foreign Private Issuer) on June 24, 2026, reporting results from its annual general meeting of shareholders held on June 23, 2026. All resolutions presented were approved, including the election of seven director nominees with over 97% votes for each, and the reappointment of MNP LLP as auditor with 98.75% votes for. The meeting represented 32.22% of outstanding shares. Details were previously provided in a management information circular dated May 22, 2026. This is a routine shareholder meeting outcome filing and does not constitute a special situation.
